page: Amazon Web Services m8gd.8xlarge is a general-purpose, 8th-generation cloud server driven by the AWS Nitro hypervisor and ARMv9 architecture. The instance offers 32 dedicated physical cores powered by AWS Neoverse-V2 CPUs running at 2.8 GHz, with a 1:1 core-to-thread allocation that eliminates virtualized hyper-threading overhead. Cache hierarchy includes 64 KB L1 data cache per core, 2 MB L2 cache per core, and a shared 36 MB L3 cache. Memory capacity sits at 128.0 GB, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The instance includes 1900 GB of local NVMe SSD instance storage and 15 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, operating without discrete GPU accelerators.

Benchmark measurements highlight exceptional memory subsystem throughput and strong parallel computing capability. In memory benchmarking, the server achieves top-tier results with 363.94 GB/sec on uncached large-block reads and 182.89 GB/sec on large-block writes, complemented by a top-decile PassMark memory score of 3321.52. Multi-threaded processing demonstrates high efficiency, registering 21404.0 on Geekbench multi-core and 47242.75 on PassMark database operations. Redis throughput reaches 67.21 million operations per second, while static web serving throughput measures 73.58 GB/sec. Conversely, single-core metrics fall within average industry percentiles, and large-scale 70B parameter LLM prompt processing reflects lower throughput due to CPU-bound execution.

From an efficiency perspective, the architecture maximizes resource utilization through dedicated physical arm64 cores and dense integrated NVMe storage, removing the reliance and variable latency associated with networked block storage volumes for scratch or ephemeral data. The high memory bandwidth and strong multi-core scaling provide solid cost efficiency for distributed caching layers, relational and non-relational database nodes, continuous integration compilation tasks, and high-throughput static web infrastructure.
description: Amazon Web Services m8gd.8xlarge is a general-purpose instance featuring 32 dedicated physical arm64 cores powered by AWS ARMv9 Neoverse-V2 processors running at 2.8 GHz on the Nitro hypervisor. Configured with a standard 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio, it supplies 128.0 GB of RAM alongside 1900 GB of direct-attached NVMe SSD instance storage and 15 Gbps baseline networking, without GPU acceleration. The instance excels in memory-intensive and parallel workloads, registering top-tier large-block memory read/write bandwidth and strong performance in multi-core metrics, including PassMark database operations and Redis transactions. Single-core performance and large LLM inference remain within standard ranges. With dedicated single-threaded cores and high-speed local storage, the instance is well suited for transactional databases, Redis caching layers, Clang software builds, and high-traffic web delivery.
